name: OPA209 / OPA2209 / OPA4209
type: Bipolar precision op-amp, 36 V, RRO, 1/2/4 channels
tagline: Low-power 36 V precision part (2.2 nV/√Hz, rail-to-rail output); Head-Fi rollers praise its detail and treble clarity.

lineage.note: SBOS426 first issued November 2008. Sole manufacturer; no second source known.

part_numbers.note: Single. OPA209AIDBVT (SOT-23-5), OPA209AIDR (SOIC-8); MSOP-8 probable. Status inferred from live page.
Dual. OPA2209AID (SOIC-8); MSOP-8 also listed. TI marks it ACTIVE.
Quad. OPA4209AIPW (TSSOP-14). Status inferred from live product page.

key_specs.condition: 25 °C; typ only from mirror file name

reputation.summary: A favourite of several rollers in Head-Fi's 'The Opamp thread' and the xDuoo XD-05 threads. One poster calls it their 'favorite bipolar', citing 'amazing resolution and detail level', deep soundstage, air and 'the best treble detail and clarity'. Others found it 'somewhat laid back' like the OP275, or with a brighter, noisier background than the OPA1692. Individual forum impressions.
typical_uses: Rolling in xDuoo XD-05 (needs SMD-to-DIP adapter)
caveats: Praise is subjective, from a handful of Head-Fi posters.
One comparison heard a brighter or noisier background than the OPA1692.
A precision general-purpose part, not a TI SoundPlus audio part.
SMD packages only; DIP-8 sockets need an adapter board.

counterfeit_notes: No specific counterfeit reports found. TI makes the family only in SOT-23-5, MSOP-8, SOIC-8 and TSSOP-14, so any 'DIP-8 OPA2209' is an adapter board or a fake. Check markings; buy from authorised distributors.
